theorem typeI2_mu_first {δ T : ℝ} {q : ℕ} (hT : 6e6 ≤ T) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (ht2 : 2 ≤ delta0 δ * q) (htT : delta0 δ * q ≤ T / 3) :
    T ^ 3 / (2 * q) * minInv c₀ (π * δ) *
        muBound (min (3 / 4 * T ^ 2 / (2 * V1 T)) (U1 T (delta0 δ * q))) q *
        Real.log (V1 T * q) ≤
      2.8 * (2 * T ^ 3 / (delta0 δ * Nat.totient q)) +
        (1.5 * Real.log (delta0 δ * q) + 1.309) * (2 * T ^ 3 / (delta0 δ * q)) :=

note: Lean bounds (6.12) in a different shape: a constant 2.8·2x/(δ₀φ(q)) with the logarithm moved to the x/(δ₀q) slot, the 2q/φ(2q) factor for odd q included, and 0.152·2x/t (from ψ(y) ≤ 1.0064y, book 1.0004y) for 0.29315x/(q²δ₀). Erratum: (i) Before (6.12) the sum over (m,2q)=1 is bounded by (4/5)(q/phi(q))/log^+(M_v/2q^2), but (2.22) at modulus 2q gives (4/5)(2q/phi(2q)), twice that for odd q; at x=2.16e20, q=223, small delta the correctly bounded first line of (6.12) is 0.05025x, above the 0.04889x of all of (6.58), so the first term of (6.58) is not established for odd q; doubling it always suffices, though for some odd q (e.g. 3, 5, 15) the printed term still follows. (checked by `scripts/checks/eq_6_58.py`).
